Beach days, Portland style. ✨

Winnifred Beach is a local favourite on the north east coast.

Rent a car and go see it for yourself.

Getting there: It is east of Port Antonio. Allow about 2.5 hours from Kingston.

Jerk in Boston Bay is close by, so plan lunch.
